summary: Configured `/swapfile` on node1 as a 512 MiB swap file, activated it immediately, persisted it through `/etc/fstab`, and confirmed automatic reactivation after reboot.
actions_performed: Created `/swapfile` at exactly 536,870,912 bytes with root ownership and mode 0600.
Initialized and activated the swap file.
Added `/swapfile none swap defaults 0 0` to `/etc/fstab` and validated the configuration.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed node1 recovered healthy and `/swapfile` was automatically activated during the new boot.

evidence.requirement: 512 MiB swap file is active now and configured for future boots
evidence.summary: Shows the exact 536,870,912-byte size, mode 0600, live swap activation, valid swap signature, persistent `/etc/fstab` entry, and active systemd swap unit sourced from `/etc/fstab`.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID f54d7366-0403-4b05-93bb-b5c0a1818892; the reboot was acknowledged; the recovered node reported changed boot ID 78fcbc89-7e46-4d39-b7ae-d8bdd90531d2; post-restart output shows system state running and `/swapfile` automatically activated.
